object: E21 u at bit 29 (dE21 = e0000000): other signed patterns
question: Do the other signed patterns of dE21 = e0000000 (weight<=6: 3 alternatives) reach the same later differences and the 38-step event?
number: Window, 4 seeds (2^27 samples): u30 n29 prefix cost 1.00 bit, EXACT 95 of base 5230, event weight 0.0091 of base; n31 n30 n29 prefix cost 2.00 bit, EXACT 2, weight 0.0001; u31 n30 n29 EXACT 0 (2 seeds). backward rows 17..25: row 22 needed-X Pr 0.5 -> 1/32 (u30n29) and 1/512 (nnn, unn), rows 23/24 halve or quarter; rows 17..21 unchanged. The first alternative reaches the event at about 1% of the printed rate; the others are below resolution.
notes: Universe cell sha256-38|r21|E|Q4. Union of printed + alternatives would add at most +0.013 bit of event weight; not a lever. Method: variant chi38 file per alternative (work/chi/*.txt, generated by work/gen.py from chi/chi38.txt; every other line unchanged), traillab window --rows 22 37 --event out --no-elist --autolist --np 4096 --mt 8192 --threads 3, seeds 9301,9302 (and 9303,9304 where an alternative stayed alive); unmodified chi38 reproduces atlas_runs38/H-drops/out/base.txt bit for bit on seeds 9301,9302 (work/out/_regression_base.txt: EXACT 1320/1265, prefix -84.995/-85.055). 'dead' = the SMC stage accepted 0 of 1,048,576 proposals on each seed. Window/prefix model only (no full-path check).
